entry.title: Vaduz Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles ground; reconstructed raised court.

entry.note: Appearance checked against two aerial pictures; signed north-south orientation distinguishes covered south roundel from open north roundel. Standard viewer Protomaps/Mapzen PMTiles set location and hillside fit at anchor 9.52434566,47.139574837 and heading 1.549323723192. Y0 is the working terrain sample 563.3922911400916m; reconstructed court10m above it clears the coarse hillside and bounded foundations extend below sampled ground. Exterior walls and floors are approximate, not surveyed. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
